title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the streets and corridors surrounding Austin College, from the historic downtown square to the campus-adjacent residential blocks in Sherman.

cards.title: The Main Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Grand Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk south from campus to find local student-friendly spots like CJ's Coffee Cafe, a popular independent hub for study sessions and award-winning brews.
cards.short_summary: The primary north-south artery bordering the Austin College campus and connecting it to local services.
cards.evidence_claim: Austin College is located at 900 N. Grand Avenue, and CJ's Coffee Cafe is a local favorite situated on Travis Street nearby.
cards.source_title: Campus Offices & Services at Austin College | Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: Public street accessible 24/7; local businesses have varying hours.

cards.title: Upperclassman Living Hub
cards.subtitle: Brockett Street Corridor
cards.notes: This street houses the Bryan Apartments and the Flats at Brockett Court, providing suite-style living options for junior and senior students.
cards.short_summary: A key residential corridor on the southern edge of campus housing several college-owned apartment complexes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryan Apartments are located at 1112 E. Brockett St. and the Flats at Brockett Court are at 916 E. Brockett Court.
cards.access_notes: Residential street; apartment access is restricted to residents and guests.

cards.title: Downtown Dining and Culture
cards.subtitle: Travis Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Old Iron Post for casual dining or stop by the Sherman Public Library for local history resources and community programs.
cards.short_summary: A major downtown street featuring historic buildings, local restaurants, and the city's public library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Old Iron Post is located at 101 N. Travis St. and the Sherman Public Library is at 421 N. Travis St.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Sherman, TX - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Public downtown street; library hours vary by day.

cards.title: The White Rabbit Coffee Hub
cards.subtitle: Crockett Street Corridor
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of 100 S. Crockett St. to find White Rabbit Coffee House, a modern space for study and award-winning espresso.
cards.short_summary: A downtown corridor known for the White Rabbit Coffee House and its proximity to the historic courthouse square.
cards.evidence_claim: The White Rabbit Coffee House is located at 100 S. Crockett St. Unit 200 in downtown Sherman.
cards.source_title: Contact 2 — Coffee Sherman, Tx | The White Rabbit Coffee House
cards.access_notes: Coffee house open daily; accessible via stairs or elevator.

cards.title: Local Brews and Burgers
cards.subtitle: Houston Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore 903 Brewers for a community-focused taproom experience with a full food menu, located just blocks from the downtown square.
cards.short_summary: A central east-west street featuring local favorites like 903 Brewers and Sage Cafe.
cards.evidence_claim: 903 Brewers is located at 221 W. Houston St. and Sage Cafe is at 210 W. Houston St.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and taproom open Tuesday-Sunday; check website for specific hours.

cards.title: The Sherman Museum Block
cards.subtitle: Walnut Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Sherman Museum to explore Grayson County history, housed in a historic Carnegie Library building.
cards.short_summary: A historic street home to the Sherman Museum and various professional services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sherman Museum is located at 301 S. Walnut Street in Sherman.

cards.title: Lucy Kidd-Key Park
cards.subtitle: Pecan Street Corridor
cards.notes: Relax at Lucy Kidd-Key Park, which features a large gazebo and historical remnants of a former women's college.
cards.short_summary: A street bordering the scenic Lucy Kidd-Key Park and the municipal grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucy Kidd-Key Park is located at 373 W. Pecan St. in Sherman.
cards.source_title: Lucy Kidd-Key Park – Sherman Parks & Rec
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Salvadoran Flavors
cards.subtitle: Lamar Street Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by Pupuseria Los Primos for authentic Salvadoran cuisine, located just a short drive or bike ride from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: An east-west corridor featuring diverse local eateries like Pupuseria Los Primos.
cards.evidence_claim: Pupuseria Los Primos is located at 200 E. Lamar St. in Sherman.

cards.title: The Arts and Government Hub
cards.subtitle: Mulberry Street Corridor
cards.notes: Home to the Honey McGee Playhouse and Sherman City Hall, this street is a center for local theater and civic life.
cards.short_summary: A key downtown street housing the Sherman Community Players' playhouse and city government offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honey McGee Playhouse is located at 313 W. Mulberry St. and City Hall is at 220 W. Mulberry St.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Sherman, TX - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Public street; theater performance times vary.

cards.title: Off-Campus Residential Life
cards.subtitle: Taylor Street Corridor
cards.notes: Located near Fairview Park, this street features apartment communities like The Parks on Taylor, popular with students eligible to live off-campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential street west of campus providing off-campus housing options and park access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Parks on Taylor is located at 1200 W. Taylor St. near Fairview Park.
cards.source_title: Modern Apartments Near Austin College in Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: Residential street; apartment access is restricted to residents and guests.
